subject.title: [Bug]: web_fetch reports exact-size responses as truncated

question: What evidence and bounded-read contract are sufficient before accepting an exact-limit `readResponseText` fix for this issue?
rationale: A member closed the earlier standalone fix as not planned without an explicit content-length/overread contract or real failing response, so automation should not choose that contract on its own.

options.title: Require contract/proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a fix defines bounded overread or content-length behavior, preserves stalled/empty-stream safety, and includes real helper or `web_fetch` proof.

options.title: Accept the source-level helper fix
options.body: Allow a narrow `readResponseText` patch based on the source-level exact-limit repro, with focused tests and ordinary maintainer review.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Close the issue if maintainers decide exact-limit inference should not be treated as a supported `web_fetch` correctness contract.

recommendation.title: Require contract/proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a fix defines bounded overread or content-length behavior, preserves stalled/empty-stream safety, and includes real helper or `web_fetch` proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc provided the same-cluster maintainer signal that created the current proof/contract requirement.
